Name: Soft Farmer - Slightly Cuter Sprites
Author: Crisaius
Description:
[b]Soft Farmer redesigns the playable farmer[/b] with customizable body types, hairstyles, clothing, and accessories, along with seasonal sleeve and footwear styles, and additional visual options, all with a slightly cuter aesthetic.

[img]https://imgur.com/jm9chje.png[/img]

• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇬🇧[/size][/color] English (Default)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇪🇸[/size][/color] Spanish (Español)
• [color=#e69138][size=4]🇨🇳[/size][/color] Chinese (中文) - Translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/yuquansun]yuquansun[/url]

Language is selected automatically based on the game language.

- [i]La descripción completa en español se encuentra disponible al final de esta página. / A full Spanish description is available at the end of this page.[/i]

[img]https://imgur.com/P4gmhQX.png[/img]

•[b] Vanilla-friendly farmer redesign[/b] inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url].
• [b]Expanded body customization [/b]for male and female farmers, including multiple body types, chest shapes, and optional muscular definition.
• [b]Face and eye customization [/b]with different eye, face, and ear styles, nose visibility, and heterochromia options.
• [b]Seasonal sleeve and footwear[/b] customization with independent settings for each season and Ginger Island.
• [b]Redesigned clothing and appearance assets[/b], including hairstyles, shirts, pants, skirts, hats, accessories, and footwear
• [b]Customizable mannequins [/b]with independent body type, sleeve, and footwear settings.
• Optional [b]Quality of Life add-on[/b] with no-shirt appearances, visible pregnancy changes, and additional compatibility improvements.
• Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url].

[img]https://imgur.com/zeLF08G.png[/img]

[color=#e69138][b]1[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[color=#e69138][b]2[/b][/color]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32081]BlinkFix[/url].
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. (Optional) Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]5[/color][/b]. (Optional) Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] for best visual consistency.
[quote][b]⚠️[/b]  If "Seasonal Cute Characters" is installed, make sure the option [b]FarmerBase[/b] or [b]SlightlyCuterFarmer[/b] is set to [b]false[/b] (via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu).[/quote][b][color=#e69138]6[/color][/b]. Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
[b][color=#e69138]7[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://imgur.com/kQkaEbs.png[/img]

Soft Farmer includes multiple configuration options through [b]Content Patcher[/b].

Settings can be edited via [b]config.json[/b] or with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (if installed).
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]General[/color][/b]
[i]General visual settings and compatibility options.[/i]

　• [b]Enable Soft Farmer Mod: [/b]Enables or disables all visual changes added by the mod.
　• [b]Use Custom Hats: [/b]Enables Soft Farmer custom hats instead of vanilla hats.
　• [b]Use Summer Outfits in Desert:  [/b]Enables summer sleeves and footwear while in Calico Desert, regardless of the current season.
　• [b]Use Chest Shape by Gender:[/b] Enables independent chest shape settings for female and male farmers. When disabled, shirts use their integrated chest shapes instead, which is recommended for multiplayer games with farmers of different genders.
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Farmer Appearance [/color][/b]
[i]Customize body shape and facial features. Some options are shared globally, while others can be configured independently for female and male farmers.[/i]

[color=#e69138]Global Options[/color]
[i]Shared by both female and male farmers.[/i]

[b]Face Shape [/b]— Changes the overall shape of the farmer's face.
　• Classic
　• Rounded

[b]Ear Style [/b]— Changes the appearance of the farmer's ears. Some hairstyles and accessories may adjust depending on the selected style.
　• Classic
　• Protruding

[b]Hide Noses: [/b]Toggles the visibility of the farmer's nose on character sprites.

[color=#e69138]Gender-Specific Options [/color]
[i]These options can be configured separately for female and male farmers.[/i]

[b]Eye Styles [/b]— Configured independently for female and male farmers and provides subtle variations in facial expression.
　• Neutral
　• Soft
　• Steady

[b]Body Types [/b]— Configured independently for female and male farmers. Affects the torso, shoulders, and arms.
　• Classic
　• Soft
　• Robust

[b]Chest Shape [/b]— Configured independently for female and male farmers and mainly affects the character's side silhouette.
　• Flat
　• Prominent

[color=#e69138]Additional Male Options[/color]
[i]Settings exclusive to male farmers. [/i]

　• [b]Muscular Classic Body: [/b]Adds muscular definition while preserving the Classic body shape.
　• [b]Muscular Robust Body: [/b]Adds muscular definition while preserving the Robust body shape.
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Seasonal Sleeve & Footwear Styles [/color][/b]
[i]Female and male farmers can use independent settings based on season and location. [/i]

Available settings for:
　• Spring
　• Summer
　• Fall
　• Winter
　• Ginger Island

[b]Sleeve Styles [/b]— Changes sleeve length for the selected season or location.
　• Long
　• Short
　• Sleeveless

[b]Footwear Styles [/b]— Changes footwear for the selected season or location.
　• Long Boots
　• Short Boots
　• Long Dainty
　• Short Dainty
　• Flat Sandals
　• Fine Sandals
　• Barefoot
　• Delicate Barefoot
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Other Settings [/color][/b]
[i]Additional clothing and appearance settings. [/i]

[b]Adaptive Pant Length: [/b] Configured independently for female and male farmers. Automatically adjusts "Farmer Pants" and "Tight Pants" to better match the selected footwear.

[b]Heterochromia [/b]— Configured independently for female and male farmers. Applies a preset color to the right eye while the left eye retains the eye color selected in-game.
　• Brown
　• Hazel
　• Green
　• Turquoise
　• Blue
　• Purple
　• Gray
[i]The Quality of Life add-on is recommended for proper heterochromia display in side-facing sprites.[/i]

[b]Invisible 'Tank Top' Shirt:[/b] Male option that makes the "Tank Top" shirt item invisible, revealing the farmer's body underneath. [i]This option is ignored when the Quality of Life add-on is installed.[/i]
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Quality of Life Add-on [/color][/b]
[i][i]Optional add-on that introduces additional visual features and compatibility improvements for Soft Farmer. [/i][/i]

　• [b]No Shirt Appearance:[/b] Replaces the default white undershirt shown when no shirt is equipped with a Bra Top for female farmers and a Bare Torso for male farmers.
　• [b]Pregnancy Appearance: [/b]Adds gradual visible body changes throughout pregnancy.
　• [b]Directional Support: [/b]Improves side-facing behavior for features such as heterochromia and provides additional support for Soft Farmer add-ons.
　• [i]Includes additional compatibility improvements, including support for Fashion Sense. [/i]
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Mannequins[/color][/b]
[i]Customize mannequin appearance independently from player farmers. [/i]

Available customization options:
　• Body Type
　• Sleeve Style
　• Footwear Style

[img]https://imgur.com/2pHBxqL.png[/img]

📱 [b]Mobile (Android / iOS)[/b]
This mod [b]may work on mobile[/b], but mobile compatibility is [b]not officially supported[/b]. Some features or configurations may behave differently.

﻿⚠️ [b]May cause visual inconsistencies with Fashion Sense
﻿[/b] Both mods can be installed together without crashing, but Soft Farmer modifies the farmer's base body, arms, clothing, and proportions.

✅ [b]Compatible with Seasonal Cute Characters
﻿[/b] To avoid conflicts, make sure the [b]FarmerBase[/b] or [b]SlightlyCuterFarmer[/b] option in Seasonal Cute Characters is [b]disabled[/b].

﻿❌ [b]Not compatible with mods that replace the farmer base, hairstyles, hats, accessories, shirts, or pants
[/b] Soft Farmer replaces many core farmer assets, so using other mods that edit the same textures may cause visual issues.

[img]https://imgur.com/g03zHCI.png[/img]

Special thanks to [b]Poltergeister[/b], creator of [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/i], whose work inspired the overall style and served as a visual foundation for many of the refinements in this project.

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29404525][b]AlanBF[/b][/url], creator of [i][b]BlinkFix[/b][/i], for adding compatibility with Soft Farmer and improving the farmer's blinking behavior, helping provide better visual consistency across Soft Farmer and its add-ons.

Thanks to [b]yuquansun[/b] for providing the Chinese translation.

All referenced assets and inspirations are credited in detail in the [b]Permissions and credits[/b].
[b]This mod is non-commercial.[/b]

[color=#e69138][size=5]🇪🇸[/size][/color] [b]DESCRIPCIÓN COMPLETA AL ESPAÑOL[/b] 
[spoiler]
[b]Soft Farmer rediseña al personaje jugable[/b] con nuevos tipos de cuerpo, peinados, ropa y accesorios, además agrega estilos estacionales de mangas y calzado, y opciones visuales adicionales, todo con una estética ligeramente más cute.

[img]https://imgur.com/Bo6u1qV.png[/img]

• [b]Rediseño vanilla-friendly del jugador[/b] inspirado en [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url]﻿.
• [b]Múltiples tipos de cuerpo[/b] (Clásico, Suave, Robusto) para personajes masculinos, femeninos y maniquíes.
• [b]Personalización estacional[/b] de mangas y calzado con configuraciones independientes para cada estación e Isla Jengibre.
•[b] Rediseño[/b] de peinados, camisas, pantalones, faldas, sombreros, accesorios y calzado adaptados a los nuevos tipos de cuerpo.
• [b]Tres estilos de ojos[/b] para personajes masculinos y femeninos (Neutros, Suaves, Firmes).
• [b]Opciones visuales adicionales[/b], incluyendo visibilidad de nariz, camisa sin mangas invisible y definición de torso clásico masculino.
• Maniquíes con configuraciones independientes de tipo de cuerpo, mangas y calzado.
• Totalmente configurable mediante [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[b] [/b]y [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/i].

[img]https://imgur.com/Sam3FaW.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Instala la última versión de[b] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Instala la última versión de [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b].
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] (Opcional) Instala la última versión de [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/b] para una mejor coherencia visual.
[quote]⚠️ Si está instalado "Seasonal Cute Characters", asegúrate de que la opción [b]FarmerBase, SlightlyCuterFarmer [/b]o [b]Cambio del personaje jugador[/b] (si tienes el parche en español) esté configurada en [b]false[/b] (a través de [b]config.json[/b] o [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]).[/quote][color=#e69138][b]4.[/b][/color] Extrae este mod dentro de la carpeta [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b].
[b][color=#e69138]5.[/color][/b] Ejecuta el juego usando SMAPI.

[img]https://imgur.com/8w8NUmA.png[/img]﻿

Soft Farmer incluye múltiples opciones de configuración mediante [b]Content Patcher[/b].

La configuración puede editarse mediante [b]config.json[/b] o utilizando [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (si está instalado).
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]General[/color][/b]
[i] Configuraciones generales y opciones de compatibilidad visual.[/i]

　• [b]Activar Soft Farmer: [/b]Activa o desactiva todos los cambios visuales añadidos por el mod.
　• [b]Ocultar Nariz:[/b] Oculta la nariz del personaje en los sprites del juego.
　• [b]Usar Sombreros Personalizados:[/b] Usa los sombreros personalizados de Soft Farmer en lugar de los sombreros vanilla.
　• [b]Usar Ropa Veraniega en Desierto: [/b]Usa mangas y calzado de verano en el Desierto de Calico, independientemente de la estación actual.

[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Apariencia del Jugador[/color][/b]
[i] Personaliza la apariencia de los personajes masculinos y femeninos con variaciones corporales suaves y compatibles con el estilo vanilla.[/i]

[b] Tipos de Cuerpo [/b]— Elige entre tres tipos de cuerpo:
　• Clásico
　• Suave
　• Robusto
[i]Cada tipo de cuerpo modifica el torso, hombros y brazos. [/i]

[b] Estilos de Ojos [/b]— Elige entre tres estilos de ojos:
　• Neutros
　• Suaves
　• Firmes
[i]Estas opciones añaden variaciones sutiles a la expresión facial. [/i]

[color=#e69138] Opciones Adicionales para el Personaje Masculino[/color]
　• [b]Definición de Torso Clásico:[/b] Añade una definición muscular sutil mientras conserva las proporciones clásicas vanilla.
　• [b]Camisa sin Mangas (M) Invisible:[/b] Hace invisible la prenda “Camisa sin mangas (M)”, dejando visible el cuerpo del personaje debajo.
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Estilos de Mangas Estacionales [/color][/b]
[i] Personaliza el largo de mangas de forma independiente según la estación y ubicación. [/i]

Configuraciones disponibles para:
　• Primavera
　• Verano
　• Otoño
　• Invierno
　• Isla Jengibre

Estilos de mangas disponibles:
　• Largas
　• Cortas
　• Sin mangas
[i]Los personajes masculinos y femeninos utilizan configuraciones de mangas independientes.[/i]
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Estilos de Calzado Estacionales [/color][/b]
[i] El calzado también puede personalizarse de forma independiente según la estación y ubicación.[/i]

Estilos de calzado disponibles:
　• Botas largas
　• Botas cortas
　• Zapatos finos largos
　• Zapatos finos cortos
　• Sandalias planas
　• Sandalias finas
[i]Los personajes masculinos y femeninos utilizan configuraciones de calzado independientes. [/i]
[line]
[b][color=#e69138]Maniquíes [/color][/b]
[i] Personaliza la apariencia de los maniquíes de forma independiente al jugador. [/i]

Opciones de personalización disponibles:
　• Tipo de Cuerpo
　• Estilo de Mangas
　• Estilo de Calzado

[img]https://imgur.com/JjpTp0f.png[/img]
﻿﻿
📱 [b]Móvil (Android / iOS)[/b]
Este mod [b]puede funcionar en dispositivos móviles[/b], pero la compatibilidad no está oficialmente soportada. Algunas funciones o configuraciones pueden comportarse de manera diferente.

⚠️ [b]Puede causar inconsistencias visuales con Fashion Sense[/b]
Ambos mods pueden instalarse juntos sin provocar errores, pero Soft Farmer modifica el cuerpo base del jugador, los brazos, la ropa y las proporciones.

✅ [b]Compatible con Seasonal Cute Characters[/b]
Para evitar conflictos, asegúrate de que la opción [b]FarmerBase[/b], [b]SlightlyCuterFarmer[/b] o [b]Cambio del personaje jugador[/b] (si tienes instalado el parche del español) en Seasonal Cute Characters esté configurada [b]desactivada[/b].

❌ [b]No compatible con mods que reemplacen el cuerpo base del jugador, peinados, sombreros, accesorios, camisetas o pantalones[/b]
Soft Farmer reemplaza múltiples assets principales del jugador, por lo que usar otros mods que editen las mismas texturas puede causar problemas visuales.

[img]https://imgur.com/ybRPyYx.png[/img]

Agradecimientos especiales a [b]Poltergeister[/b], creador de [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/i], cuyo trabajo inspiró el estilo general y sirvió como base visual para muchos de los refinamientos de este proyecto.

Gracias a [b]yuquansun[/b] por proporcionar la traducción al chino.

Todos los assets referenciados y las inspiraciones están acreditados en detalle en [i][b]Permissions and credits[/b][/i][b][i].[/i][/b]
[b]Este mod es no comercial.[/b]

﻿[/spoiler]
